name: Korinek et al. 2026 faithful port: Extreme scenario
description: Sets the faithful port (korinek-2026-faithful.json, the Substantial scenario) to the paper's EXTREME scenario by changing only its Table 1 scenario values (m_2030, d_2030, the mid-2026 gain and its slope, psi, rho, mu, theta^H). No equation is touched: in the paper the three scenarios differ only in these numbers. Its own tests assert every row of the Extreme column of Table 3 (p.31) at the paper's rounding, and the path slopes of Table A.2.
